# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.12

Version 1.4.12 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.11

**Seamless acres.** On the GameCube the town is cut into acres: the camera stays inside the one you are in, and
walking into its edge stops you while the game walks you on by itself for about 0.6 seconds and the camera sweeps
over to the next acre. Now, outside in town (and on the island), you walk straight on from one acre into the next:

- no stop at the edge: you keep walking, running or dashing as you were;
- the camera follows you over the edge and keeps you in the middle of the screen;
- the next acre is already there as it comes into view: its houses, shops, mailboxes, gyroids, snowmen and the like
  are set up before you reach them, and those you leave behind stay until they are off the screen;
- everything the game does when you come into an acre happens as before (its insects and fish come out, villagers
  walk in, events and the music follow, the sunburn shows), at the moment you step in. A ball keeps rolling and bees
  keep flying as you cross.

It is on by default. **Settings** → **Gameplay** → **Seamless acres** turns it off, and then crossing is exactly as on
the GameCube. It changes nothing indoors, in the title demo or on your first day's arrival by train, and pushing a
snowball into the next acre still scrolls as before.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.12 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together. Each player's own setting decides how they cross acres.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.12-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.12-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.12-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.12-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

With the setting **off**, the game is unchanged: the same scripted play as for v1.4.11 (43 scenarios: the opening,
building interiors and saving, the town by day, night and rain, the Famicom, the device menus, several days with
letters, K.K. Slider, the house loan and events, Nook's part-time job, the Korean text editor), run on v1.4.11 and on
this version, gives the same 921 screenshots pixel for pixel, the same logged positions and the same saves.

With the setting **on**:

- 40 crossings over the town in every direction: the player walks on wherever v1.4.11's scroll would have taken
  them (and stops where it would not have, against cliffs and water), and the game's acre follows every time;
- walking into a building, and leaving the scene, right after a crossing; walking back and forth over an edge;
- the island, both of its acres and the boat trip there and back;
- a house just across an edge is there in view before the crossing, and nothing is made and taken away over and
  over at the screen's edge;
- the title demo gives the same screenshots as with the setting off;
- the 32-bit and 64-bit builds give the same screenshots and positions throughout, and a 64-bit build with
  AddressSanitizer and UBSan bounds checks found no memory errors (only the original game's out-of-range reads
  that are already listed in the docs).

Also:

- An independent review of the code, in two rounds; what it found is fixed.
- All unit tests pass. The decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.12, versionCode 10412).

How it works: [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md#seamless-acres).

## Known limitations

- With seamless acres, the villagers and insects of the next acre come out when you step into it (as at the start of
  the GameCube's crossing), so one may appear in view then.
- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- No test on a real arm64 device was possible here; arm64 runs the same 64-bit code that was checked on x86_64.
- In Korean mode, passwords cannot be entered: their characters are kana and symbols that the Korean patch's
  input has no keys for, and its font shows some pairs of them as one Hangul syllable. This is how the patch is
  made, also on the GameCube.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
